note: Files copied verbatim from the repository this one forked. Anything NOT listed here is written for this build. Run scripts/sync-core.mjs --check to see what has drifted.

divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/dashboard-shapin: one import line: './peek.svelte' → './peek'. The 782-line test needs only parseSubject, which is pure; the rest of peek.svelte.ts is a Svelte rune store. Re-point rather than lose the test.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/pipeline.test.ts: the commissioned-model case uses OpenRouter ids instead of Codex ones, matching the catalogue this build actually offers. Same assertions; `max` remains an effort the model will not take, because it is a Codex-only level.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/persistence.inte: the DATABASE_URL guard becomes a temp-directory guard, and the two browser-driven sections are gated on POLICY_PREVIEW_ORIGIN until phase 4 has a UI to point at.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/personas.integra: the DATABASE_URL guard becomes a temp-directory guard.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/provider.integra: the DATABASE_URL guard becomes a temp-directory guard.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/sealed.integrati: the DATABASE_URL guard becomes a temp-directory guard, AND an upstream bug is fixed: census.ts has twelve probes, the assertion said eleven.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/share.ts: TWO UPSTREAM BUGS fixed. `persona_link` is withheld as well: its data carries the merged standing dossier — traits, continuity, divergence — drawn from the owner's OTHER assessments, which this module's own header says must never travel. And the fromId/toId pruning was a no-op, both ternary branches returning the same value. Both worth reporting upstream.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/share.test.ts: the WITHHELD_KINDS assertion pins the list, so it names persona_link too. Everything else in the file derives from the constant and adapts.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/server/ingest.ts: the commissioned model is validated against the OpenRouter catalogue (src/lib/server/models/catalogue.ts) rather than CODEX_MODELS, and effort levels come from the openrouter provider. Without this the picker is inert in a standalone install.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/server/bundle.ts: FACES is empty: this build sets text in Helvetica Neue and Arial, which readers already have, and may not ship GDS Transport. The pack carries no font bytes.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/offline/html.ts: the pack's <html> and <body> carry GOV.UK's shell classes, without which version 6 styles nothing, and the generator string names this build rather than the site.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/offline/pack.tes: asserts that NO font travels in the pack, rather than that three do.
Routes search/extract through $lib/server/web-search so an install with no Tavily key falls back to the provider's grounded web search instead of answering no research questions at all.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/research.test.ts: Mocks $lib/server/web-search instead of $lib/deepdive/tavily, matching the one-line divergence in research.ts, so upstream's eight retrieval assertions keep running against the fork's wiring.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/view.ts: Gives BAND_FILL real values and adds BAND_INK. Upstream's ramp is var(--accent) plus three color-mix steps off it, and neither property is defined in this build — so the one consumer, ExposurePlot, painted every mark black.
divergences.src/lib/policy-analysis/pipeline.ts: orderedContext is wired into three of the nine fan-out sites; stages 7, 9, 10 and 16 skip it and cached 225,792 of 10,116,528 input tokens on the live run (2.2%), against 67.5% and 85.1% for the wired ones. This applies the same fix to all four — stage 10 takes stage 14's shape, and orderedContext gains an optional protect set for the three whose context is entirely shared.

notCopied.src/lib/server/owner.ts + client-address: SvelteKit request guards. Phase 4's node:http server does this itself; nothing in the pipeline reads them.
notCopied.src/lib/policy-analysis/server/access.ts: A SvelteKit route guard over @sveltejs/kit's error/json/RequestEvent. Replaced in phase 4.
notCopied.src/lib/llm/pricing.ts: Reads an `openrouter_models` price table this build does not have. The pipeline's own audit in policy_model_calls is the cost record that matters.
